paite: Benjamin gam a Anathoth a siampute lak a mi Hilkiah tapa Jeremiah thute:
heading: Jeremiah
english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

paite: Judah Kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah hun lai, avaihawm akum sawm-le-thumna ah akiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

paite: Judah kumpipa, Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm lai in leng ahong tung a; Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Zedekiah akum sawm-le-khatna tawp, Jerusalem sal a pi akha ngana tan in.
english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Jeremiah Sapna
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Gilsung a ka hon bawl ma in ka hon thei a, sul a kipan a na pawtkhiak ma in leng ka hon koihtuam a, namte kiang a zawlnei hi ding in ka hon sep khin," chi in.
english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Eh, Toupa PATHIAN, ngai dih, thu ka gensiam kei, ka naupang ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Ka naupang, chi ke'n, ka hon sawlna peuhmah kiang ah na hoh ding a, ka hon thupiak peuhmah na gen ding ahi.
english: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

paite: Amaute lau ke'nla, nang hon hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om hi," chi in.
english: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon sawk a, ka kam akhoih a, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah,
english: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

paite: "Ngai in, na kam ah ka thute ka koihta, en dih, namte leh kumpipa gamte tung ah, botkhe ding, phel ding, hihse ding, paikhe ding, bawlhoih ding leh dingkhesak ding in tuni in ka hon koih na hi," achi hi.
english: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, "Jeremiah, bang na mu?" achi hi. Ke'n, “Vaisuaklu singhiang ka mu," ka chi hi.
heading: Mengmuhna Nihte
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Na mu kha mahmah ve; ka thu tangtun ding in ka kigalging gige ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

paite: Huan anihveina ding in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a, "Bang na mu a?" chi in. Ke'n bel, "Bel sou bolhbolh, agong mallam nga ka mu," ka chi hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Gam a tengte tung ah mallam a kipan thil hoih lou ahong tung ding.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

paite: Ngai dih, mallam kumpipa gam nam tengteng ka sam ding; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ahong pai ding ua, Jerusalem kongpi lutna ah, akimvel kulhbaang tengteng chin ah leh Judah khopi teng ah alaltutphah uh atung chiat ding uh.
english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

paite: Hon paisan in, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, amau khutsuak mah abia ua; hiai athulimlouhna teng tungtang ua ka thugelte ka puang ding hi.
english: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

paite: Huaiziak in puan teng inla, thou inla, ka hon thupiak teng akiang uah va gen in; ama uah lunglel ke'n, huchi lou in zaw ama uah ka hon lunglelsak kha ding hi.
english: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

paite: Ngai in, tuni in nang, agam pumpite, Judah kumpipate, aheutute, asiampute leh agam mipite dou in khopi kulh a um leh sik khuam leh dalsik khuam in ka hon bawl ahi.
english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

paite: Hon sual ding ua, himahleh ahon zou kei ding uh; hon hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”
